sessions.description_vi: Khám phá tính cách dựa trên tháng sinh của bạn.
sessions.value:
# People: character and behaviour

## A Your month of birth and your character

**Astrological Forecast**

**January** You are **good company**¹ but you may have a **selfish streak**².

**February** You have an **outgoing personality** and a **good sense of humour**.

**March** You have a **vivid imagination**, but you tend to **lose your temper** too easily.

**April** You are **highly intelligent** with a **razor-sharp mind**.

**May** You set **high standards** for yourself and are **fiercely loyal** to your friends.

**June** The best aspect of your personality is the way you always **put others first**.

**July** Although you can be **painfully shy** in social situations, at work you give the impression of being **supremely confident**.

**August** You have a tendency to make **snap decisions**⁴.

**September** You have a **strong sense of responsibility** and always **keep your word**⁷.

**October** You are good at keeping secrets and never **bear a grudge**⁶.

**November** You find it hard to **keep your temper**⁸ if you think someone is **making a fool of you**⁹.

**December** You can be **brutally honest**⁹ and sometimes **hurt others’ feelings**.

¹ people enjoy being with you

² you sometimes act in a selfish way

³ stronger than extremely

⁴ quick decisions

⁵ do what you say you will do, keep your promises

⁶ resent for a long time bad things others have done to you

⁷ not get angry

⁸ trying to deceive or trick you

⁹ honest in a way that may hurt

sessions.description_vi: Học các cụm động từ + danh từ liên quan đến hành vi.
sessions.value:
# People: character and behaviour

## B Behaviour: verb + noun collocations

| collocation                | example                                                                                              |
| -------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| **play a joke/trick**          | The children **played a joke** on the teacher by hiding under their desks before she came into the room. |
| **take a joke**                | Fortunately, the teacher could **take a joke** and didn’t punish them.                                   |
| **swallow your pride**         | Isabella **swallowed her pride** and admitted that she was wrong.                                        |
| **throw a tantrum**            | The child **threw a tantrum** when I wouldn’t buy him any sweets.                                        |
| **lose your patience**         | Finally I **lost my patience** and shouted at her.                                                       |
| **come to terms with**         | Nick has found it hard to **come to terms with** his illness.                                            |
| **reveal your true character** | Daniel’s failure to support her has certainly **revealed his true character**.                           |

**Tip**

Associating these collocations with people you know may help you to learn them.

image.value: people enjoying being together

senses.definition_vi: sự dễ chịu khi ở bên cạnh, người mà người khác thích ở cùng.
examples: You are good company, and I always enjoy our chats.
senses.usage_notes_vi: Được dùng để mô tả một người mà người khác thích ở cùng vì họ vui vẻ, thú vị hoặc dễ chịu.

use_prompts.question: Which family member do you enjoy spending time with most?
What makes someone a good travel partner?
Why are pets good for older people living alone?

dictation.text: You are good company, and I enjoy our chats.

paraphrase.source: I always enjoy spending time with my grandfather.
paraphrase.model: My grandfather is always good company.

paraphrase.source: A dog is a pleasant friend for someone who lives alone.
paraphrase.model: A dog is good company for someone who lives alone.

image.value: a person acting selfishly

senses.definition_vi: một đặc điểm hoặc hành vi ích kỷ thỉnh thoảng xuất hiện.
examples: He's usually very generous, but he has a selfish streak when it comes to money.
senses.usage_notes_vi: Chỉ ra rằng ai đó đôi khi hành động ích kỷ, mặc dù họ có thể không phải lúc nào cũng như vậy.

use_prompts.question: Are only children more selfish than children with brothers and sisters?
What makes some colleagues difficult to work with?
Do top athletes need to be a little selfish to succeed?

dictation.text: He is kind, but he has a selfish streak.

paraphrase.source: He is usually generous, but sometimes he only thinks about himself when it comes to money.
paraphrase.model: He's usually very generous, but he has a selfish streak when it comes to money.

paraphrase.source: Even kind people sometimes behave selfishly.
paraphrase.model: Even kind people have a selfish streak.

image.value: a friendly and sociable person

senses.definition_vi: tính cách hướng ngoại, cởi mở và thân thiện.
examples: Her outgoing personality made it easy for her to make new friends.
senses.usage_notes_vi: Mô tả một người thích giao tiếp xã hội, thân thiện và cởi mở.

use_prompts.question: What kind of person makes a good salesperson?
Why do some students make friends more easily than others?
What kind of people enjoy travelling alone?

dictation.text: Her outgoing personality helps her make new friends.

paraphrase.source: She is so friendly and sociable that she makes new friends easily.
paraphrase.model: Her outgoing personality makes it easy for her to make new friends.

paraphrase.source: Hotel staff need to be friendly and confident with strangers.
paraphrase.model: Hotel staff need an outgoing personality.

image.value: people laughing together

senses.definition_vi: khả năng nhận thức và đánh giá sự hài hước, hoặc khả năng làm cho người khác cười.
examples: He has a great sense of humour and can always make me laugh.
senses.usage_notes_vi: Chỉ khả năng hiểu và phản ứng với sự hài hước một cách tích cực.

use_prompts.question: What qualities make a good boss?
What qualities do you value most in a partner?
What makes a teacher popular with students?

dictation.text: My teacher has a good sense of humour.

paraphrase.source: He is funny and can always make me laugh.
paraphrase.model: He has a good sense of humour and can always make me laugh.

paraphrase.source: Students love teachers who can make them laugh.
paraphrase.model: Students love teachers with a good sense of humour.

image.value: a person daydreaming with colorful thoughts

senses.definition_vi: khả năng tưởng tượng phong phú và sống động.
examples: Children often have a vivid imagination, creating fantastical worlds in their play.
senses.usage_notes_vi: Mô tả khả năng tưởng tượng mạnh mẽ, tạo ra hình ảnh hoặc ý tưởng rõ ràng trong tâm trí.

use_prompts.question: Why do children enjoy making up stories?
What qualities does a good novelist need?
Do video games help children become more creative?

dictation.text: Children often have a very vivid imagination.

paraphrase.source: Children can picture fantastical worlds very clearly in their play.
paraphrase.model: Children often have a vivid imagination, creating fantastical worlds in their play.

paraphrase.source: The writer can create very clear and colourful pictures in her mind.
paraphrase.model: The writer has a vivid imagination.

image.value: a person looking angry

senses.definition_vi: trở nên tức giận đột ngột.
examples: He tends to lose his temper when he's stressed.
senses.usage_notes_vi: Diễn tả hành động mất kiểm soát cơn giận.

use_prompts.question: How do people react when they are under pressure at work?
Should parents ever shout at their children?
Why do drivers sometimes behave aggressively?

dictation.text: He tends to lose his temper when he is stressed.

paraphrase.source: He often gets angry suddenly when he is stressed.
paraphrase.model: He tends to lose his temper when he's stressed.

paraphrase.source: The coach got very angry and shouted at the players.
paraphrase.model: The coach lost his temper and shouted at the players.

image.value: a person thinking deeply with a lightbulb above their head

senses.definition_vi: rất thông minh.
examples: She is a highly intelligent student who grasps complex concepts quickly.
senses.usage_notes_vi: Nhấn mạnh mức độ cao về trí thông minh.

use_prompts.question: Should very gifted students be taught separately?
Do the cleverest people always become the most successful?
Which animals do you think are the cleverest?

dictation.text: She is a highly intelligent student.

paraphrase.source: She is a very clever student who understands difficult ideas quickly.
paraphrase.model: She is a highly intelligent student who grasps complex concepts quickly.

paraphrase.source: Dolphins are extremely clever animals.
paraphrase.model: Dolphins are highly intelligent animals.

image.value: a sharp, focused mind represented by a sharp object

senses.definition_vi: trí tuệ sắc bén, nhạy bén và có khả năng phân tích tốt.
examples: With his razor-sharp mind, he could solve the most difficult puzzles.
senses.usage_notes_vi: Mô tả một trí tuệ cực kỳ sắc sảo, nhanh nhạy và hiệu quả.

use_prompts.question: What qualities does a good lawyer or detective need?
How can older people keep their brains healthy?
What makes someone very good at solving problems?

dictation.text: My grandmother still has a razor-sharp mind.

paraphrase.source: He thinks very quickly and clearly, so he can solve any puzzle.
paraphrase.model: With his razor-sharp mind, he can solve any puzzle.

paraphrase.source: Even at ninety, she can still think very quickly and clearly.
paraphrase.model: Even at ninety, she still has a razor-sharp mind.

image.value: a bar set very high

senses.definition_vi: tiêu chuẩn cao, yêu cầu chất lượng hoặc hiệu suất cao.
examples: She sets high standards for herself and always strives for excellence.
senses.usage_notes_vi: Chỉ ra rằng ai đó mong đợi hoặc yêu cầu chất lượng hoặc thành tích rất tốt.

use_prompts.question: What makes a company successful in the long term?
Should teachers be strict with students?
Why are some restaurants more popular than others?

dictation.text: She sets high standards for herself at work.

paraphrase.source: She expects excellent work from herself and always tries her best.
paraphrase.model: She sets high standards for herself and always strives for excellence.

paraphrase.source: The hotel expects very good quality in everything it does.
paraphrase.model: The hotel has high standards in everything it does.

image.value: a person protectively standing by another

senses.definition_vi: trung thành một cách mãnh liệt, không lay chuyển.
examples: He is fiercely loyal to his family and friends.
senses.usage_notes_vi: Nhấn mạnh mức độ cao của sự trung thành, không dễ dàng bị lung lay.

use_prompts.question: How important is loyalty to family in your culture?
Why do some fans support their team even when it loses?
What makes employees stay with one company for many years?

dictation.text: He is fiercely loyal to his friends.

paraphrase.source: He will always support his family and friends, no matter what.
paraphrase.model: He is fiercely loyal to his family and friends.

paraphrase.source: The fans always stand by their club, even in bad times.
paraphrase.model: The fans are fiercely loyal to their club, even in bad times.

image.value: a person helping someone else before themselves

senses.definition_vi: ưu tiên nhu cầu hoặc mong muốn của người khác hơn của bản thân.
examples: She's the type of person who always puts others first.
senses.usage_notes_vi: Diễn tả hành động đặt lợi ích của người khác lên trên lợi ích của mình.

use_prompts.question: What makes a good nurse or doctor?
What do you admire most about your parents?
Should people help their community even when it costs them time?

dictation.text: My mother always puts others first.

paraphrase.source: She always thinks about other people's needs before her own.
paraphrase.model: She always puts others first.

paraphrase.source: Good leaders care about their team more than about themselves.
paraphrase.model: Good leaders put others first.

image.value: a person looking very uncomfortable in a social setting

senses.definition_vi: cực kỳ nhút nhát, đến mức gây khó chịu hoặc bất tiện.
examples: He was painfully shy and found it difficult to speak in front of the class.
senses.usage_notes_vi: Nhấn mạnh mức độ nghiêm trọng của sự nhút nhát, gây ra sự khó chịu.

use_prompts.question: Why do some students never speak in class?
Why do some people find job interviews very difficult?
How can parents help a child who is afraid of strangers?

dictation.text: He was painfully shy as a child.

paraphrase.source: He was so shy that it was difficult for him to speak in class.
paraphrase.model: He was painfully shy and found it difficult to speak in class.

paraphrase.source: My sister was extremely nervous with strangers when she was young.
paraphrase.model: My sister was painfully shy when she was young.

image.value: a person standing tall and smiling confidently

senses.definition_vi: cực kỳ tự tin.
examples: Despite the challenges, she remained supremely confident in her abilities.
senses.usage_notes_vi: Nhấn mạnh mức độ rất cao của sự tự tin.

use_prompts.question: What mental qualities do top athletes need?
How should candidates behave in a job interview?
How do the best students feel before an exam?

dictation.text: The team was supremely confident before the final.

paraphrase.source: She was completely sure of her abilities, despite the challenges.
paraphrase.model: Despite the challenges, she remained supremely confident in her abilities.

paraphrase.source: The champion felt extremely sure he would win.
paraphrase.model: The champion was supremely confident of winning.

image.value: a person making a quick choice

senses.definition_vi: những quyết định nhanh chóng, thường được đưa ra mà không suy nghĩ kỹ.
examples: He's known for making snap decisions, which sometimes leads to problems.
senses.usage_notes_vi: Chỉ những quyết định được đưa ra rất nhanh, đôi khi thiếu cân nhắc.

use_prompts.question: Is it ever a good idea for managers to decide important matters quickly without much thought?
Why do some shoppers buy things that they regret later?
Why do some people lose money when they invest in the stock market?

dictation.text: He often makes snap decisions and regrets them later.

paraphrase.source: She decided very quickly to quit her job without thinking it through.
paraphrase.model: She made a snap decision to quit her job.

paraphrase.source: Online shoppers often choose what to buy quickly and without careful thought.
paraphrase.model: Online shoppers often make snap decisions about what to buy.

image.value: a person carrying a heavy load responsibly

senses.definition_vi: ý thức mạnh mẽ về trách nhiệm, cảm giác có nghĩa vụ phải làm điều gì đó.
examples: She has a strong sense of responsibility towards her job.
senses.usage_notes_vi: Mô tả một người coi trọng và thực hiện nghĩa vụ của mình một cách nghiêm túc.

use_prompts.question: What qualities do children develop when they help with household chores?
What personal qualities make someone a good team leader?
Why do some people recycle even when nobody checks on them?

dictation.text: She has a strong sense of responsibility at work.

paraphrase.source: Nurses usually feel a deep duty to look after their patients.
paraphrase.model: Nurses usually have a strong sense of responsibility towards their patients.

paraphrase.source: Older children often feel that they must take care of their younger siblings.
paraphrase.model: Older children often have a strong sense of responsibility for their younger siblings.

image.value: a person shaking hands on a promise

senses.definition_vi: giữ lời hứa, làm những gì bạn đã nói sẽ làm.
examples: You can trust him; he always keeps his word.
senses.usage_notes_vi: Diễn tả việc thực hiện cam kết hoặc lời hứa đã đưa ra.

use_prompts.question: What do voters expect from politicians after an election?
How can a new employee earn the trust of their manager?
What should parents teach their children about making promises?

dictation.text: If you make a promise, you should keep your word.

paraphrase.source: If you promise to help someone, you should do what you said.
paraphrase.model: If you promise to help someone, you should keep your word.

paraphrase.source: Many voters believe that politicians rarely do what they promise.
paraphrase.model: Many voters believe that politicians rarely keep their word.

image.value: a person holding onto anger towards another

senses.definition_vi: giữ sự oán giận hoặc tức giận đối với ai đó trong một thời gian dài vì những điều họ đã làm.
examples: She's not the type to bear a grudge; she forgives easily.
senses.usage_notes_vi: Chỉ hành động không tha thứ cho lỗi lầm trong quá khứ và tiếp tục cảm thấy tức giận.

use_prompts.question: Why do some family arguments last for many years?
How should colleagues behave after a disagreement at work?
Should athletes forgive opponents who played unfairly against them?

dictation.text: She never bears a grudge against her friends.

paraphrase.source: He is still angry with his brother about something that happened years ago.
paraphrase.model: He still bears a grudge against his brother for something that happened years ago.

paraphrase.source: Good team members forgive each other quickly after an argument.
paraphrase.model: Good team members do not bear a grudge after an argument.

image.value: a person staying calm despite provocation

senses.definition_vi: kiềm chế cơn giận, không để bản thân trở nên tức giận.
examples: It's important to try and keep your temper, even in difficult situations.
senses.usage_notes_vi: Diễn tả hành động kiểm soát và không thể hiện sự tức giận.

use_prompts.question: How should shop staff deal with rude customers?
What is the best way for parents to respond when children misbehave?
How should passengers behave when their flight is delayed for hours?

dictation.text: Try to keep your temper when people are rude.

paraphrase.source: It is hard to stay calm when someone insults you.
paraphrase.model: It is hard to keep your temper when someone insults you.

paraphrase.source: Teachers must stay calm even when students behave badly.
paraphrase.model: Teachers must keep their temper even when students behave badly.

image.value: a person tricking or deceiving another

senses.definition_vi: làm cho ai đó trông có vẻ ngớ ngẩn hoặc bị lừa dối.
examples: He felt like they were making a fool of him when they lied about the meeting.
senses.usage_notes_vi: Diễn tả hành động lừa dối hoặc khiến ai đó trông ngớ ngẩn.

use_prompts.question: Why do some people feel angry about hidden camera TV shows?
How might an employee feel if colleagues laugh at their mistakes in meetings?
Why should people be careful about believing everything they read online?

dictation.text: I think they are making a fool of you.

paraphrase.source: I think your friends are tricking you and laughing at you behind your back.
paraphrase.model: I think your friends are making a fool of you behind your back.

paraphrase.source: Don't let that salesman trick you into paying too much.
paraphrase.model: Don't let that salesman make a fool of you by charging too much.

image.value: a person speaking harsh truths directly

senses.definition_vi: thẳng thắn một cách tàn nhẫn, nói sự thật mà không quan tâm đến cảm xúc của người khác.
examples: She's brutally honest, sometimes to the point of being hurtful.
senses.usage_notes_vi: Mô tả sự thẳng thắn đến mức có thể gây tổn thương hoặc khó chịu.

use_prompts.question: Should managers be completely direct when they give feedback to staff?
Do you prefer friends who always tell you the hard truth?
Why are some judges on TV talent shows so popular?

dictation.text: My sister is brutally honest about my cooking.

paraphrase.source: The coach told the players the harsh truth about their poor performance.
paraphrase.model: The coach was brutally honest with the players about their poor performance.

paraphrase.source: Some reviewers say exactly what they think, even if it hurts.
paraphrase.model: Some reviewers are brutally honest, even if it hurts.

image.value: a person looking sad after being spoken to harshly

senses.definition_vi: làm tổn thương cảm xúc của người khác.
examples: He didn't mean to hurt their feelings with his criticism.
senses.usage_notes_vi: Diễn tả hành động gây ra sự buồn bã, tổn thương về mặt tình cảm cho người khác.

use_prompts.question: Why should people think carefully before posting comments online?
What should children learn about being kind to classmates?
How should managers give negative feedback to their staff?

dictation.text: It is wrong to hurt others' feelings on purpose.

paraphrase.source: Rude comments on social media can upset other people deeply.
paraphrase.model: Rude comments on social media can deeply hurt others' feelings.

paraphrase.source: Children should learn that unkind jokes can make other people sad.
paraphrase.model: Children should learn that unkind jokes can hurt others' feelings.

image.value: children playing a prank on someone

senses.definition_vi: chơi khăm, thực hiện một trò đùa hoặc mánh khóe với ai đó.
examples: The students decided to play a trick on their teacher.
senses.usage_notes_vi: Sử dụng 'play a joke' hoặc 'play a trick' để chỉ hành động thực hiện một trò đùa.

use_prompts.question: Why do some students enjoy fooling their teachers?
Is there a day in your country when people try to fool each other?
Is it acceptable to fool colleagues for fun in the office?

dictation.text: The children played a trick on their teacher.

paraphrase.source: My brother hid my phone just to fool me for fun.
paraphrase.model: My brother played a trick on me by hiding my phone.

paraphrase.source: On April Fools' Day, people try to fool their friends for fun.
paraphrase.model: On April Fools' Day, people play jokes on their friends.

image.value: a person smiling after a joke is played on them

senses.definition_vi: chấp nhận một trò đùa, không bị khó chịu khi ai đó chơi khăm mình.
examples: He has a good nature and can always take a joke.
senses.usage_notes_vi: Diễn tả khả năng đón nhận và không phản ứng tiêu cực với một trò đùa.

use_prompts.question: What kind of personality helps people get along with their colleagues?
Why do some people get upset when their friends tease them?
Should politicians accept being laughed at by comedians on television?

dictation.text: He laughs easily and can always take a joke.

paraphrase.source: She gets angry whenever someone teases her a little.
paraphrase.model: She can't take a joke when someone teases her.

paraphrase.source: Public figures must not get upset when comedians make fun of them.
paraphrase.model: Public figures must be able to take a joke from comedians.

image.value: a person reluctantly admitting fault

senses.definition_vi: làm điều gì đó mặc dù nó làm tổn thương lòng tự trọng hoặc khiến bạn cảm thấy xấu hổ.
examples: He had to swallow his pride and ask for help.
senses.usage_notes_vi: Diễn tả hành động vượt qua sự kiêu hãnh hoặc xấu hổ để làm điều cần thiết.

use_prompts.question: Is it difficult for experienced workers to ask younger colleagues for help?
How can family members end a long argument?
Why are some students unwilling to admit they do not understand a lesson?

dictation.text: Sometimes you must swallow your pride and say sorry.
